entities.name: Tomáš Zohorna
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tomáš Zohorna is a Czech professional ice hockey player. He is currently under contract with HC Kometa Brno in the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He has two brothers, Radim and Hynek. They are hockey players too, they used to play for HC Kometa Brno.
